    Overview

    Make movement part of your everyday routine with the Tria Standing Desk, the do-it-all centerpiece that adjusts to your workflow while improving health and productivity. Three sizes up to 71” provide ample room for serious work, while three-stage lifting columns accommodate a wide range of statures. Built-in Bluetooth pairs with the Branch Ergonomics app to add automatic stand tracking, scheduled stands, and more.

    • Spacious size options
    • Bluetooth connectivity
    • Cable management included
    • Resistant desktop
    • Lift range of 25.5” - 48.9”
    • 2 memory presets

    • Three-stage lifting columns reach from 25.5" to 48.9", covering a wider range of statures both sitting and standing
    • Lift capacity of 275 lbs
    • Three generous desktop sizes (48”, 58”, 71”) provide ample room for serious work
    • Available in 5 desktop finishes to suit your workspace style
    • OLED keypad stores two programmable height presets with one-touch recall, and adds USB-C charging right where you work
    • Collision detection and sedentary reminders keep you moving safely
    • Integrated cable port and included felt organizer keep wires neatly arranged, with optional tray and in-desk power for heavy-duty setups
    • Customize with Desk Tray, Desk Hook and/or Headphone Stand
    • Built-in Bluetooth pairs with the Branch Ergonomics app for virtual presets, stand tracking, scheduled stands and more

Product details

Overview
Dimensions

Tria is a do-it-all standing desk designed to maximize space, adjustability, lift capacity, and connectivity for serious work. Three sizes and 23" of range make it a natural fit for a dedicated home office space or shared workspaces that need to fit every body. An array of premium finishes from natural oak to white complement any workspace style.

With an integrated cable port and included felt organizer, Tria keeps wires neatly tucked away, while an optional cable tray and in-desk power support more robust setups. The OLED keypad offers two presets, sedentary reminders, and a USB-C charging port within easy reach. Pair it with the Branch Ergonomics iOS app for automatic movement tracking, scheduled standing sessions, and a more active workday. Complete your Tria with easy install accessories from desk trays to a headphone stand.

  • Brand
    Branch
  • General Dimensions
    48” x 27” | 58” x 27” | 71” x 30”
  • Product Weight
    105 - 132 lbs
  • Assembly

  • Materials

  • Compatible With

    Tria Cable Tray, In-Desk Power, Desk Tray, Headphone Stand, Desk Hook, Desk Perch, Monitor Arm

  • Warranty
    10 years

About the Collection

Tria Collection

The Tria collection is built for serious workdays. Every desk in the collection is designed around smart connectivity, generous size options, and integrated cable management that keeps up with the most demanding setups.

The Tria Standing Desk, L-Standing Desk, and Double Standing Desk each share the same three-stage lifting columns, intuitive Bluetooth keypad, and integrated cable management system. Choose the configuration that fits your space and the way you work.
